name: a fresh replica is bound and its intents are admitted in order, each with a change frame
a resend of admitted n's is answered from sync_results and changes nothing
ackThrough prunes the stored results at or below it
a resend of an n whose result was pruned answers replica-forked
a stored n resent with another digest answers replica-forked
an n past lastN + 1 answers gap and leaves no binding behind
a replica bound to another account answers replica-foreign
no principal answers 401
the admission budget answers retry naming the first unprocessed n
a transient fault records nothing and answers retry with a wait
a deterministic fault is counted and answers retry
the K_POISON-th fault stores internal, advances lastN, and the next intent proceeds
a body without ackThrough is 400 malformed
an intent without an integer n is 400 malformed
more intents than PUSH_MAX_INTENTS is 413
a request over PUSH_MAX_BYTES is 413
a board delete emits its change frame, then a death event per killed scope
a replica id other than rp_ and 32 lowercase hex is 400 malformed
a body with a key beyond replica, ackThrough and intents is 400 malformed
a 409 prunes nothing: results at or below ackThrough stay
an answer replayed from sync_results spends no admission budget
ackThrough above lastN prunes nothing above lastN: the next n keeps its fault count
